entities.summary: Paul Le Roux (b. 1972-12-24, Bulawayo) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bulawayo and Zimbabwe. Known in the fields of zimbabwe, merchants & economists, africa.
